notes.title: Dev Update: Smoother Skies Ahead!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Hey Skybenders![/p][p]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback — and we hear you loud and clear! Our team is currently hard at work fine-tuning the [b]onboarding experience[/b] for [i]Dominate the Skies[/i]. [/p][p]We want every new pilot to feel confident, capable, and combat-ready from the moment they strap in. That means:[/p][p]✅ Streamlined tutorials.
✅ Clearer HUD!
✅ More intuitive mission progression.
✅ A smoother learning curve for both flight and combat mechanics.[/p][p]Whether you’re a rookie getting into your first anti-gravity dogfight or a seasoned ace returning for another round, the upcoming updates will help you take off faster and fly smarter.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more details soon — and as always, thanks for being part of this growing community.[/p][p]Now go out there and [b]Dominate the Skies[/b]!
 — Team DTS[/p]
